label: TP
reason: The user-provided parameter 'param' flows through the 'doSomething' method and is used as a format string in 'response.getWriter().format(bar, obj)' on line 52. This constitutes a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability because the attacker can inject malicious content into the format string which will be rendered in the browser.

evidence.note: The parameter 'param' is retrieved from the request and passed to 'doSomething' method
The variable 'bar' (which contains user input) is used as a format string in response.getWriter().format()
